newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Poh Lian Holdings to list shares in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Poh Lian Holdings to list shares in Singapore.

text.p: Poh Lian Holdings, an integrated access equipment supplier, said on Thursday it had received in-principle approval to list on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.

"Having established a foundation in Singapore, Poh Lian is now embarking on its next phase of growth in building a regional presence," Tan Eng Khiam, company chief executive officer said in a statement.
"The listing will support our efforts to expand selectively in high growth economies such as Malaysia and China," Tan said.
The group provides access equipment, such as scaffolds, mast-climbing work platforms and gondolas, to support the construction, marine engineering and petrochemicals industries.
The group has also diversified into construction and niche property development to tap the residential and infrastructure-related construction projects.
It said between 1992 and 1996, group turnover almost doubled to Singapore $182 million from S$94 million while pre-tax profit rose to S$8.7 million from S$77,000.
United Overseas Bank would be the manager, underwriter and lead placement agent for the initial public offer.
